This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:

Order 
This is first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.4/2023 registered at Police Station Salamatpur, District Raisen (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n), 376(i.3), 376 (3) of IPC and Section 3/4, 5-L/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is aged about 18 years.
She on her own came to applciant and lived with applicant for about two months.

During said periord she did not raised any hue and Rahul Raikwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190824570/

sentences.text: Later on, she was recovered and lodged FIR against the applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that FSL report is positive.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is aged about 18 years of age.
She was having relationship with applicant.
Applicant is also a young man.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.
7.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
